tiers.name: ScorX Free

limits.games_note: 20 saved games in total, not per month. At the cap you can't save a new game until you delete one or upgrade to Premium.

score: Team mode and individual stat recording
Player rotations and playing time tracking
track: Game history and stats (up to 20 saved games)
train: Measure: 14 baseline athleticism metrics with trend and progress chart
Goal mode: target per metric with goal line on the chart
Development Plan: skill slots with 2 drills each, outcome goal, S&C goal
Run drills: Beep Test, 800m time trial, 2km time trial
Drill Library and Drill Animator (AFL first), including save and import
Play Library and Play Animator, including save and import
Training Sessions and Run Session with beep pacing
Drill assignment to a squad and team results
devices: iPad Team Mode (magnet board, lineup planning)

tiers.notes: Scoring, tracking and training tools. Free forever, no credit card required. Limits: 5 teams, 25 players, 20 saved games.

tiers.name: ScorX Premium
tiers.trial_scope: Full Premium: every Premium feature, with no team, player or game limits.

features: Unlimited teams, players and saved games
Voice stat recording (team sports, iOS 26 and later)
AI Training Recommendations (personalised, regenerates every 30 days or after 5 games)
Full run drill library (sprint and interval drills)
Share Cards carousel and premium card designs
Custom colour themes and card configurator

tiers.notes: Removes the Free limits and adds AI training intelligence, voice recording, the full run drill library and the full card library. Includes everything in ScorX Free.
